children.value: dṛśye dravye darśane cakṣuṣi ca līnaṃ tadubhayādhīnasiddhikamiti yāvat
cetanapadena cetanāvato jaḍāśasyāpi grahaṇaṃ mābhūditi tatpariśodhāyāha anena cetaneneme sarve ghaṭapaṭādayaḥ

sarvāsāmanubhava eṣāmastītyanubhavino
dehendriyamanobuddhyādayastadbhāvānāṃ anubhavitānāmanubhavānāṃ bhūmiḥ
paraṃ viśrāntisthānam
asya tasya mamemāni sthāvarāṇi carāṇi ca
mayedamāpyate sarvaṃ sattā māṃ prāpya gacchati

dṛśyaṃ darśanārha sthāvaraṃ jaṃgamaṃ vā vibhūtimacchrīmadūrjitaṃ vā
tasya sarvasyotkarṣanimittaṃ cidātmatattvaṃ ahameva kiṃ
saṃkalpādidūṣitajīvarūpeṇa netyāha - sarvasaṃkalparahitamiti
ādyā rasamayī śaktī rasaugho vistṛto yayā
svasṛṣṭakāryāntarānupraveśena jīvasaṃvidvaicitrye'pi svayameva heturityāha ghṛtaṃ yathāntaḥ payaso rasaśaktiryathā jale
idaṃ jagattrikālasthaṃ citi madhye ca saṃsthitam
sarvasthaḥ sarvakartā ca virāṭ samrāḍahaṃ sthitaḥ
gajo bilva iva svāṅge na māti vipulaṃ vapuḥ
ko dehaḥ ko'pyadeho vā ko mṛtaḥ kaśca jīvati
prāptaprāpyo mahātmāyaṃ jīvāmi ca jayāmi ca
ajñena saṃtarpayatā kiṃ nāma guruṇā kṛtam

idaṃ jaḍaduḥkharūpamapi
dehendriyaviṣayādyānandayati ānandarūpatayānubhāvayatīti vā idamānandastam
tyaktvā padamidaṃ mūrkho mitameti na paṇḍitaḥ
uṣṭro hi tyaktasulataḥ kaṇṭakaṃ yāti netaraḥ
parāṃ dṛṣṭimimāṃ tyaktvā dagdharājye rameta kaḥ
mūrkhā eva hi te sarve babhūvurme pitāmahāḥ
sarvayā sarvadā sarvaṃ sarvataḥ sādhu labhyate
bhavatyātmā tathā brahma na kiṃciccākhilaṃ ca vā
sā hi noḍḍayituṃ śaktā pāśabaddheva pakṣiṇī
uddhṛtosi vikalpebhyo yosi sosi namostu te

svavapuṣi mudite svayaṃ svasaṃsthaṃ
svayamuditaṃ svavaśaṃ svayaṃ namāmi
